packet_status: informational: prerequisites that an adopter checkout must satisfy before scripts/rev-harness-distribution-adoption.sh --check can be cited as acceptance evidence. Nothing in the checker reads this field; it exists to document, for a human reader, why a freshly cloned distribution does not pass the check out of the box.
